query:
INSERT INTO groups (id, org_id, key, name, source, created_at, updated_at)
         SELECT new.id, $1, new.key, new.key, $4,
                timestamptz 'epoch' + $5::bigint * interval '1 microsecond',
                timestamptz 'epoch' + $5::bigint * interval '1 microsecond'
         FROM unnest($2::uuid[], $3::text[]) AS new (id, key)
